Tanushree Dutta Faces Backlash for Remarks on Nana Patekar's Death

Following the death of actor Nana Patekar, Tanushree Dutta made a remark stating "Evil is dead," which led to her facing online trolling. Several celebrities and singers have since come out in support of Dutta. Singer Chinmayi Sripada stated that "Demise doesn't make a harasser an angel," defending Dutta and asserting that a person's death does not absolve them of past actions. This support comes amid criticism directed at Dutta for her comments.
